item.title: Edmonton Oilers' Matt Savoie looking anything but a rookie right now
item.description: "I feel like it takes a while to figure out the pro game; when you can take chances, when you have to get it in, and doing it on a consistent basis. So, I think last year, that's just what I kind of did the whole season, was just try to figure out the pro game."

item.title: Edmonton charities raise nearly $300k in Coldest Night of the Year walkathon
item.description: Organizers say the event is a chilling reminder of the conditions many unhoused Edmontonians contend with each winter

item.title: United States 'losing political credibility' on world stage amid Iran war: U of A prof
item.description: Andy Knight says Alberta will get short-term boost in oil prices, but feel long-term pain as Middle East war will spur more and more people to find alternatives to fossil fuels

item.title: Budget 2026: RCMP union decries rising cost, role of Alberta sheriffs
item.description: The National Police Federation says Albertans have shown they don't want a provincial police service while the government says it is prioritizing public safety

item.title: Matheson: Simply put, the Edmonton Oilers need more from Darnell Nurse
item.description: "There’s been ups and downs. I know there’s more from Darnell. I’ve seen it," said Oilers coach Kris Knoblauch. “We expect him to be one of our better players, especially on the back-end"

item.title: Alberta may follow B.C. on making daylight time permanent: premier
item.description: "Our government will take these recent developments under consideration and evaluate whether a similar change would be in the best interest of Albertans," said the Alberta premier's office

item.title: Edmonton Oilers acquire safe, solid Connor Murphy from Chicago Blackhawks
item.description: Murphy, who waived his no-trade, is coming in at $2.2 million with the Blackhawks eating 50 per cent of $4.4 million AAV, a tidy bit of Bowman work
